text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, congratulations!
Wishing you a very Happy New Year~!
choice_data_list: Happy New Year! What's your resolution for this year?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Resolutions!? Um~ let's see...
Even if you ask me, I haven't really thought about anything~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How about "I want to draw a Great Fortune"?
...Though I feel like that's the same as last year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I know! What about wanting to draw a "Winner! Get one more free" stick?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And then~ how about wishing for
'getting the Last One prize' or something!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I can't think of anything at all~.
I wonder what kind of wish I should make~
choice_data_list: I'm in the Classic class starting this year, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's right. I'm not in the Junior Class
anymore. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How about "I want to win something big!"?
It's a bit vague, though.
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really! Then I'll take this one!
Once you set a goal, it makes you want to test
your luck for the year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I know! Let's go over there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu, did you think we were at a shrine? Too bad!
You can test your luck at the shopping street during New Year's too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Look, lucky bags! Let's have you pick one, Trainer, and test our luck for this year.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, which bag would you like?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A plastic bag? Oh, there's just one
see-through lucky bag here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With this, you can see what's inside, so there's no way to pick a dud!
As expected of you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I never knew you could choose like that!
I feel like I've gotten so much smarter!

There are more reliable methods than leaving things to chance.
It seems this served as a good lesson for Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A stuffed bag? Ah, here's one that's packed with stuff.
Why don't we try this one?
I opened the bag and looked inside...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, it's an assortment of leftover food.
Sweets nearing their expiration date,
carrots, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Good things come to those who wait, though! Eat this
for an explosion of vitality and to drive away malnutrition!

The meaning of those words felt a bit questionable...
but it helped restore my energy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Foot bags? Ah, you mean tabi socks.
They definitely sell those here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what makes it so "lucky,"
but maybe I'll take this chance to buy one...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Running in these might help you pick up an unexpected running form.
Let's go ahead and try the New Year's challenge right away!

I've gotten my hands on something great that will broaden my running style.
My upcoming training should make great progress now.
